There is a kind of puzzling mismatch between the very ambitious specific policy changes McDuffie is endorsing and the very modest 12,000 unit goal. 

Normally candidates do the reverse and pick a high fake number not aligned with their policies.

Why hasn’t the San Francisco Bay Area grown to be the largest conurbation in the world? It’s not even number one in the state!

This is an interesting analysis of AI’s impact on the San Francisco housing market. 

A question worth asking is why doesn’t the influx of funds generate a construction boom and tons of good blue-collar jobs instead of this displacement dynamic?

I hope they listen to this —>


David Roberts (@drvolts)

Today on Volts: more & more (especially young) people are realizing that housing & land use are core decarbonization tools -- that housing policy *is* climate policy. You know who hasn't caught on yet? Green funders. Why is that? I talk with two people in the know.
